_readme: External MCP servers for the autonomous coding agent (v4.0). Conventions follow github/github-mcp-server. 'github' is ENABLED via npx — it activates automatically once GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN is set in .env (a server whose referenced var is EMPTY is skipped safely, never spawned with a blank token). $VAR / ${VAR} values expand from .env. AGENT_MCP=0 disables all external MCP. Tool names become mcp_<server>_<tool>. Docker users: swap the npx command for the docker/ghcr.io variant from the v3.5 config.

github._note: npx works on Windows/macOS/Linux with Node installed (spawned with a shell on Windows). Needs a classic PAT with repo/issue scopes: github.com/settings/tokens. Skipped safely until the token is set.

github-remote._note: Remote GitHub MCP (no local process) — requires a GitHub Copilot OAuth token, not a PAT. Flip enabled after setting GITHUB_COPILOT_TOKEN.
